title: Save data
description: The text stored under one browser localStorage key (game/app/saves.py, SAVE_KEY): everything the game saves, as one JSON object. DRA-126. Fields are 11-save-data.md, entry_fields and last_nickname (locked), and nothing else (01-vision.md, locked decision 9; 11-save-data.md, rule 1). Design key names map as: entry_fields 'nickname' -> nickname, 'score' -> score, 'level reached' -> level_reached; last_nickname -> last_nickname; the top 10 itself -> entries. Written whole by the app after every saved entry; read and checked once at startup (docs/contracts/systems/app/save-storage.md). What the schema can't say, the app also checks: the entries are in the top-10 order (11-save-data.md, sort_and_ties; docs/contracts/systems/saves.md, Rules, Order). Data that fails any check is broken (11-save-data.md, rule 5). Owner of the schema: architect. Contract: docs/contracts/systems/saves.md.

entries.description: The top 10 in place order, #1 first: score high first, then level reached high first, then the older entry above (11-save-data.md, sort_and_ties). At most top_n entries (11-save-data.md, top_n). Empty before the first save. Maps to core.saves.Saves.entries.

last_nickname.description: The last nickname saved from the letter picker (11-save-data.md, last_nickname), or null before the first. Maps to core.saves.Saves.last_nickname.

entry.description: One run on the top 10. Maps to core.saves.ScoreEntry.

score.description: The run's final score, whole points (06-scoring.md). Never a bool.

level_reached.description: The level the run reached, 1 to 8 (08-difficulty.md; core.levels FIRST_LEVEL to LEVEL_COUNT). Never a bool.

nickname.description: 1 to 10 characters (11-save-data.md, nickname_length) from A-Z, 0-9, space and . - _ ! ? * (nickname_chars), never ending in a space: trailing blanks are dropped before saving (rule 8). Leading and inner spaces are kept. Matches core.saves.is_valid_nickname.
